description: Demonstrations of testing and electrical installation best practices to help apprentice electricians and learners training to become an electrician. Videos include practical demonstration from U.K. college lecturers to aid with learning. These videos cover electrical qualifications level 1, 2 and 3 diplomas for City and Guilds (C and G 5357, 2365, 7202, 8202, 2391 and T Levels) and EAL courses as well as AM2, AM2S AM2E. You can follow me on Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and Twitter to see our day to day progress. Hope you enjoy the journey...
